aph-ba960a20d0.s: Which is not correct regarding the Vijayanagara period?
o: The practice of sati sahagamana prevailed
There was an exchange of dowries
aph-ba960a20d0.x: Sati, polygamy and dowry were all prevalent in Vijayanagara society, and child marriages were common, so the last statement is incorrect.

aph-30836bf203.s: What was the name of Achyutaraya's Sabha Bhavana (assembly hall)?
aph-30836bf203.x: Achyutaraya's assembly hall was Venkatavilasa Mantapam, while Krishnadevaraya's was Bhuvana Vijayam.

aph-15558c8692.s: Who is popularly known as 'Kavi Samrat' in Telugu literature?
aph-15558c8692.x: Viswanatha Satyanarayana, known as Kavi Samrat, received the first Jnanpith award in Telugu for 'Ramayana Kalpavrukshamu'.

aph-63add4373a.s: Which Andhra citizen participated in the 'Vandemataram' movement along with Bipin Chandrapal, who went to many places?
aph-63add4373a.x: Gadicharla Harisarvottama Rao accompanied Bipin Chandra Pal on his 1907 Andhra tour during the Vandemataram movement.

aph-449beeb25a.s: The Sanskrit grammar book Katantra Vyakaranam was authored by?
aph-449beeb25a.x: Sarvavarma, in the court of the Satavahanas, wrote the Sanskrit grammar Katantra Vyakaranam.

aph-55d1280f3c.s: Who conquered Madurai in the south on behalf of the Vijayanagara Empire?
aph-55d1280f3c.x: Kumara Kampana, son of Bukka I, defeated the Sultan of Madurai; his wife Gangadevi described it in Madhura Vijayam.

aph-ce15443573.s: What was the largest administrative division during the Satavahana period?
aph-ce15443573.x: The Satavahanas divided their kingdom into Aharas, each under an Amatya; Soparahara and Govardhanahara were important Aharas.

aph-5d3c2a701d.s: The Vijayanagara kings are credited with achieving agricultural development by which initiatives?
o: By reducing the tax on cultivated land
By providing market facilities for agricultural produce
By purchasing food grains for their army
By constructing ponds, dams and wells
aph-5d3c2a701d.x: Vijayanagara rulers promoted agriculture by building tanks, dams and wells for irrigation.

aph-fc0ad4e5b8.s: Who established Saraswati Gachchas to promote education among common people?
aph-fc0ad4e5b8.x: The Jains established Saraswati Gachchas to spread education among common people.

aph-ef17cf1b01.s: What was the method adopted by the Rampa Rebellion?
o: Acquisition of British arms and using them for war
aph-ef17cf1b01.x: Alluri Sitarama Raju's rebels raided police stations to seize weapons and used them to fight the British.

aph-7e59a680c7.s: When did the Vajrayana branch of Buddhism emerge?
aph-7e59a680c7.x: Vajrayana Buddhism emerged in the 7th century AD.

aph-9265291eb9.s: Where are the Nava Brahma temples located?
aph-9265291eb9.x: The Nava Brahma temples were built by the Badami Chalukyas at Alampur in Jogulamba Gadwal district.

aph-62fab5672e.s: In which area did the 'Panchanam varu' (professional artisans) emerge as a group?
aph-62fab5672e.x: The five artisan castes (blacksmith, goldsmith, brazier, carpenter and sculptor) of Andhra were known as Panchanam varu.

aph-09116f5b8f.s: Whom did Gautamiputra Satakarni have to face?
aph-09116f5b8f.x: Gautamiputra Satakarni defeated the Saka (Kshaharata) ruler Nahapana and was called the destroyer of the Sakas.

aph-c6a58f65d9.s: The Satavahana ruler who married Rudradaman's daughter?
aph-c6a58f65d9.x: Rudradaman's daughter married Vasishthiputra (Sivasri) Satakarni, as known from the Junagadh/Kanheri records.

aph-ad2083a612.s: The script in which Satavahana inscriptions were written?
aph-ad2083a612.x: Satavahana inscriptions were written in Prakrit language in the Brahmi script.

aph-d66f48ffad.s: Which coin was used as currency during the Satavahana period?
aph-d66f48ffad.x: Karshapanas, minted in copper and silver, were the currency of the Satavahana period.

aph-999befe078.s: The place where Krishnadevaraya planted the victory pillar?
aph-999befe078.x: Krishnadevaraya erected a victory pillar at Potnuru on returning from his eastern campaign.

aph-1dcd8aa1a9.s: What profession did the 'Balanjalu' take up in Vijayanagara society?
aph-1dcd8aa1a9.x: The Balanjas (Veerabalijas), like the Ayyavalu, were a trading community.

aph-dccbc2f512.x: Govinda Dikshita, minister of the Tanjore Nayak Raghunatha, wrote Sahitya Sudha.

aph-e41b7fe97c.s: Who is the author of the book "Hindu Desha Daridryam"?
aph-e41b7fe97c.x: Attili Suryanarayana wrote 'Hindu Desha Daridryam' during the Vandemataram movement in Andhra.

aph-243b71acf5.s: Who established the National College at Madanapalle?
aph-243b71acf5.x: Annie Besant founded the Madanapalle National College during the Home Rule era.

aph-f8d9f25b2e.x: Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu founded the Social Purity Association in 1891 and campaigned against the Devadasi system.

aph-2a9fd5c2d8.s: Identify the wrong pair in the following pairs:
aph-2a9fd5c2d8.x: Vemulawada is known for the Rajarajeswara temple; the Swayambhu temple is in the Warangal fort.

aph-07d8d02836.s: Which of the following is the work of Gona Buddha Reddy?
aph-07d8d02836.x: Gona Buddha Reddy wrote Ranganatha Ramayanam, the first complete Ramayana in Telugu, in dwipada metre.

aph-27781498c4.s: Who among the following is known as 'Yavana Rajya Sthapanacharya'?
aph-27781498c4.x: Krishnadevaraya restored Mahmud Shah of Bidar to his throne and took the title 'Yavana Rajya Sthapanacharya'.
aph-27781498c4.key: corrected: the title belongs to Krishnadevaraya (the book's own answer key elsewhere says so)

aph-32f0f6e7f1.x: Kulottunga Chola built Visakhapatnam, which was called Kulottunga Cholapatnam.

aph-d2314ec762.s: The war between the Bahmani and Vijayanagara rulers started during whose rule?
aph-d2314ec762.x: The Vijayanagara-Bahmani conflict over the Raichur Doab began during Bukka I's reign.

aph-3faa0a405f.s: Which foreign traveler mentioned the development of the diamond industry in the Golconda region?
aph-3faa0a405f.x: Marco Polo, who visited Motupalli during Rudramadevi's reign, described the diamond industry of the region.

aph-116aa395d4.s: The 'Ashta Diggajas' (eight elephants) were in the court of which king?
aph-116aa395d4.x: The Ashta Diggajas, including Allasani Peddana and Nandi Thimmana, adorned Krishnadevaraya's court.

aph-808288bad9.s: Who founded the National College in Machilipatnam?
aph-808288bad9.x: Kopalle Hanumantha Rao founded the Andhra Jateeya Kalasala (National College) at Machilipatnam.

aph-76a203d33d.x: Kandukuri Veeresalingam founded the Hitakarini Samaj and donated his property to it.

aph-f612bdc7de.s: The first Telugu person to preside over the Indian National Congress?
aph-f612bdc7de.x: P. Ananda Charlu presided over the 1891 Nagpur session of the INC, the first Telugu and South Indian to do so.

aph-f34a2f46a7.s: Which Satavahana emperor got the title 'Dakshinapathapati'?
aph-f34a2f46a7.x: The Naneghat inscription of Naganika calls Satakarni I 'Dakshinapathapati'.

aph-ca5ad0c57a.s: Nagulapuram was built to commemorate Nagamamba. Who was Nagamamba?
aph-ca5ad0c57a.x: Krishnadevaraya built Nagalapuram in memory of his mother Nagamamba (Nagala Devi).

o: Important water resources during the Kakatiya period
Important temples of the Kakatiya period

aph-d08a70139d.x: Gangadevi, author of Madhura Vijayam, was a disciple of Agastya.

aph-2c77a55e51.s: What is the golden age of Buddhist history in Andhra?
aph-2c77a55e51.x: Under the Ikshvakus, Nagarjunakonda (Vijayapuri) became a great Buddhist centre, marking the golden age of Buddhism in Andhra.

aph-1e23f1dfe4.s: Which Chalukya king got the title 'Rajamahendra'?
aph-1e23f1dfe4.x: Eastern Chalukya Ammaraja I (Vishnuvardhana VI) bore the title Rajamahendra, after which Rajahmundry is named.

aph-a0070fcc18.s: Who is the author of 'Yayati Charitra'?
aph-a0070fcc18.x: Ponnaganti Telaganarya wrote Yayati Charitra, the first work in pure (achcha) Telugu.

aph-404af53f32.s: Who is popularly known as 'Rythu Bandhava'?
aph-404af53f32.x: Acharya N.G. Ranga, founder of the Andhra Rashtra Rythu Sangham, was known as Rythu Bandhava.

aph-f02eeeeeee.x: Devaraya II, who had the title Gajabetekara (elephant hunter), issued coins bearing it.

aph-8e3ba0b9c5.s: Who translated 15 parvas of the Mahabharata into Telugu?
aph-8e3ba0b9c5.x: Tikkana, court poet of Manumasiddhi of Nellore, translated 15 parvas of the Mahabharata.

aph-ac0beebd73.s: In which language are the Kakatiya inscriptions given?
aph-ac0beebd73.x: Most Kakatiya inscriptions are in Telugu, which flourished as an administrative language under them.

aph-a5eed87ba2.s: Where are Ashoka's inscriptions found in Andhra Pradesh?
aph-a5eed87ba2.x: Ashoka's edicts are found at Erragudi in Kurnool district.

aph-797f01396b.x: Tikkana conferred the title 'Abhinava Dandi' on Mulaghatika Ketana, who translated Dandin's Dasakumara Charitra.
aph-797f01396b.key: corrected: Abhinava Dandi is Ketana's title

aph-ee058e6cbe.s: Where did Alluri Sitarama Raju's training take place?
o: In a terrorist camp of Bihar
At the Revolutionary Corps in Chittagong
aph-ee058e6cbe.x: According to a British report, Rama Raju went to Chittagong and met the revolutionaries of Bengal.

aph-1c10085dad.s: During the time of the Satavahanas, the military bases were under the control of?
aph-1c10085dad.x: Satavahana military outposts (gulmas) were under the Gaulmika.

aph-0001877dc9.s: The village headman during the Satavahana period was called?
aph-0001877dc9.x: The village headman of the Satavahana period was called Gramika.

aph-8f38083e4c.s: The Pasupata Shaiva sect was founded by?
aph-8f38083e4c.x: The Pasupata sect, the oldest Shaiva sect, was founded by Lakulisa in the 1st-2nd century AD.

aph-a44677ad70.s: Official languages of Andhra Pradesh state?
aph-a44677ad70.x: Telugu is the official language of Andhra Pradesh and Urdu is the second official language.

aph-7ed3a6bac7.s: The Kohinoor diamond is derived from which diamond mines?
aph-7ed3a6bac7.x: The Kohinoor was found in the Kollur mines on the Krishna (Palnadu region), as noted by Tavernier.

aph-9b80fbc214.s: Which was the largest Hindu kingdom in South India in later periods?
aph-9b80fbc214.x: The Vijayanagara Empire was the largest Hindu kingdom of medieval South India.

aph-96238a56c8.s: Which ruler of Vijayanagara settled the dispute between the Jains and Vaishnavas in 1368 AD?
aph-96238a56c8.x: Bukka I settled the Jain-Vaishnava dispute in 1368 AD.

aph-ec056abd2f.s: When the First World War was going on, which movement was popular in India?
aph-ec056abd2f.x: The Home Rule Movement was launched in 1916 by Tilak and Annie Besant during the First World War.

aph-0724d5e3dc.s: Who is associated with the Justice Party?
aph-0724d5e3dc.x: The Raja of Panagal, a Justice Party leader, was Chief Minister of Madras Presidency from 1921 to 1926.

aph-fa67623ef6.s: At which place do pillars give out musical sounds?
aph-fa67623ef6.x: The musical pillars of the Vittala temple at Hampi produce musical notes when struck.

aph-4cd04411b6.s: To which deity is the 'Kotappa Konda' temple dedicated?
aph-4cd04411b6.x: Kotappakonda near Narasaraopet in Palnadu district is a temple of Lord Shiva (Trikoteswara).

aph-8f3ca55090.s: Who was the first woman to serve as Speaker of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly?
aph-8f3ca55090.x: Kavali Pratibha Bharati was the first woman Speaker of the AP Legislative Assembly.

aph-a4f1d554f3.s: Who served as the first Chairman of the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Council?
aph-a4f1d554f3.x: Madapati Hanumantha Rao was the first Chairman of the AP Legislative Council (1958).

aph-0509b2bb47.s: Who became the first Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh as a member of the Legislative Council?
aph-0509b2bb47.x: Bhavanam Venkatarami Reddy was the first to become Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh from the Legislative Council.

aph-ac33d8cf7a.s: Where was the meeting of the All India Congress Committee held in April 1921?
aph-ac33d8cf7a.x: The AICC met at Vijayawada (Bezawada) on 31 March-1 April 1921 as part of the Non-Cooperation Movement.

aph-e82c28cc92.x: The Communist Party championed Visalandhra; Puchalapalli Sundarayya wrote 'Visalandhralo Prajarajyam'.

aph-fbb385ab81.s: Who acted as the second Governor of Andhra Pradesh?
aph-fbb385ab81.x: C.M. Trivedi was the first Governor of Andhra Pradesh (1956); Bhimsen Sachar succeeded him.

aph-db1d364b64.s: Who was the first Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh?
aph-db1d364b64.x: Konda Venkata Ranga Reddy was the first Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh (1959-62).

aph-e73b5c1835.s: Which Muslim kingdom came into existence after the disintegration of the Bahmani Empire?
aph-e73b5c1835.x: The Bahmani kingdom split into five: Adil Shahi (Bijapur), Nizam Shahi (Ahmednagar), Qutb Shahi (Golconda), Barid Shahi (Bidar) and Imad Shahi (Berar).

aph-f3a4b19c68.s: The oldest of the Deccan rulers?
aph-f3a4b19c68.x: The Satavahanas, ruling roughly from 200 BC to 200 AD, were the oldest Deccan dynasty.

aph-f8efb81ea4.x: Ptolemy's Geography describes Maisolia (Machilipatnam) as a great trade centre of the Satavahana period.

aph-8e66d04f88.s: Which language is popularly known as the 'Italian of the East'?
aph-8e66d04f88.x: Telugu, with its words ending in vowels, was called the 'Italian of the East' by Niccolo Conti.

aph-8a47b01c4d.s: Which port is not mentioned by historical sources as being in use during the time of the Satavahanas?
aph-8a47b01c4d.x: Kodur, Kalyan and Sopara were Satavahana-era ports; Motupalli rose to prominence under the Kakatiyas.

aph-a21263412f.s: Which religious faith did Yajna Sri Satakarni belong to?

aph-c8da240905.x: Narasapuram on the Godavari was a noted shipbuilding centre in medieval Andhra.

aph-d2f2aeda9a.x: Gona Buddha Reddy wrote Ranganatha Ramayanam in dwipada metre.

aph-72964955cd.s: The poet who elaborately described the social and economic life of the Palnadu people?
aph-72964955cd.x: Srinatha's Palnati Veera Charitra describes the social and economic life of Palnadu.

aph-75cb35072f.x: In the Kakatiya period, Samayams were community associations, such as that of the Vaishyas.

aph-e2c53dc563.x: The Gurajala inscription belongs to Rudrapurushadatta, the last Ikshvaku ruler.

aph-ffff0ee23f.x: According to the Alluru inscription, the Buddhist community received gifts including bullock carts.

aph-4444213257.x: Hala's Gathasaptasati includes verses written by women poets.

aph-99d5096471.x: The Vipparla inscription was issued by Jayasimha Vallabha I.

aph-5b58c158a9.x: Gajula Lakshminarasu Chetty founded the Madras Native Association in 1852.
